title: Waste segregation
text: Households and businesses must segregate waste into wet (biodegradable), dry (recyclable), and hazardous streams before collection. Mixed waste may be refused by collection staff and repeat non-compliance can attract a fine.

title: Collection schedule
text: Door-to-door waste collection runs six days a week, excluding Sundays and public holidays. Bulk or construction waste requires a separate request through the sanitation department.

title: Water leak response
text: Reported pipeline leaks are triaged within 24 hours for high-urgency cases such as active flooding or contamination risk, and within 5 working days for minor seepage.

title: Water conservation
text: Use of treated water for construction, vehicle washing, or gardening during declared water-stress periods is restricted. Rainwater harvesting is required for new buildings above a specified plot size.

title: Air and noise complaints
text: Open burning of waste, including leaves and household garbage, is prohibited within municipal limits. Industrial units must stay within prescribed particulate matter and noise limits, checked periodically by the pollution control board.

title: Tree and green cover protection
text: Felling or heavy pruning of trees on public or private land above a certain girth requires prior permission from the parks and forestry department. Unauthorized felling can attract compensatory plantation requirements and fines.

title: Streetlight and energy complaints
text: Non-functional streetlights are expected to be repaired within 3 working days of being reported. Residents can request LED retrofits for older sodium-vapor lights through the electricity department.

title: Grievance response times
text: All environmental grievances receive an acknowledgement within 24 hours. High-urgency complaints are targeted for a site visit within 48 hours; medium and low urgency complaints are addressed within 7 and 15 working days respectively.
